name: daydayup
description: DayDayUp — extraction roguelite monorepo (engine, client, server, tools). See design/README.md

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npx vitest run build/versionManifestPlugin.test.mjs build/runtimeChunkPreload.test.mjs build/checkAssetHeaders.test.mjs build/checkScriptChain.test.mjs build/wechatAssetSync.test.mjs build/checkDocPaths.test.mjs build/checkRoadmapIndex.test.mjs build/checkCoverageThreshold.test.mjs build/coverageScope.test.mjs build/logicConsistency.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run test:coverage && npm run coverage:report && npm run check:coverage
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:filelength && npm run check:wechatpackage && npm run check:assetheaders && npm run check:docpaths && npm run check:roadmapindex && npm run test
scripts.test:sims: npm run test:pvp-sim && npm run test:pve-sim && npm run test:weapon-sim && npm run test:drop-sim
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:sims
